name: lol.twoweeks/elon-musk-predictions
title: twoweeks.lol Elon Musk Predictions
description: Search Elon Musk's dated predictions with his own quotes, sources, moved deadlines and verdicts.

tools.name: search_predictions
tools.description: Find Elon Musk predictions by keywords, such as a product, event or phrase he used (for example 'robotaxi', 'Mars 2024', 'Starship orbit', 'Optimus'). Use this when the user names a specific promise or subject. Returns up to 'limit' best matches, each with its claim_id, title, verdict, the date he first said it, the current deadline (YYYY-MM-DD), how many times the deadline moved, a short quote and the twoweeks.lol page URL. Call get_prediction with a returned claim_id for the full quote history and how it was graded.

query.description: Plain keywords to match against titles, quotes and topics, e.g. 'full self-driving 2020'. Not a sentence; 1 to 6 words works best.

status.description: Optional. Only return claims with this verdict.

company.description: Optional. Only return claims about this company. 'General' means not tied to one company.

tools.name: get_prediction
tools.description: Get the full record of one Elon Musk prediction: every time he said it (date, exact quote, source link, and whether it was the first statement, a restatement or a moved deadline), the first and current deadline, the verdict with a plain explanation of how it was graded, and the twoweeks.lol page URL. 'id' must be a claim_id returned by search_predictions or list_predictions (like 'c2'), a numeric statement id, or a twoweeks.lol prediction URL or slug. Do not guess ids.

id.description: A claim_id such as 'c2', a statement id such as '296', or a twoweeks.lol/predictions/<slug>/ URL or slug.

tools.name: list_predictions
tools.description: List Elon Musk predictions filtered by company, topic and/or verdict, with a count of every verdict in that group. Use this for track-record questions ('how many Tesla deadlines did he miss?', 'what SpaceX promises are still open?', 'which deadlines moved the most?') rather than for one named promise. Returns the total number of matching claims, the verdict counts for the whole group, and up to 'limit' claims in the chosen order, each with its claim_id and page URL.

company.description: Optional. Company the claim is about. 'General' means not tied to one company.

topic.description: Optional. Topic group used on twoweeks.lol.

status.description: Optional. Verdict: pending, delivered, delivered-late, missed, partial, cancelled or disputed.

sort.description: Order of the returned claims. deadline_soonest = earliest current deadline first (use with status 'pending' for what is due next). newest_said / oldest_said = by the date he first said it. most_deadline_moves = most moved deadlines first. recently_resolved = most recently graded first. Default newest_said.

limit.description: Maximum claims to return, 1 to 25. Default 10. The counts always cover the whole group.
